evals.prompt: I'm launching Ledgerline, a personal-finance app for Mac that auto-categorizes your spending and shows you a clean monthly view. I need a short punchy teaser video for Instagram Reels — vertical format, around 14-15 seconds, with a female voiceover and music. Award-style like an Apple ad, not a screencast. Deliver an mp4 I can post, plus a poster image and captions.
evals.expected_output: A finished 1080x1920 H.264/AAC MP4 of roughly 14-15s with music and female VO, a poster.jpg, and a captions .vtt file; composition respects vertical safe zones.
assertions: An MP4 video file exists in the outputs directory
Video resolution is portrait 1080x1920 (9:16 as briefed)
Video duration is between 12 and 18 seconds (brief asked for ~14-15s)
Video stream is H.264 and an AAC audio stream is present
Audio is not silent (volumedetect mean_volume above -50 dB)
A captions .vtt file was delivered (voiceover was requested)
The file decodes end to end without errors (ffmpeg -v error -f null reports nothing)

evals.prompt: Make a polished ~15 second demo film for 'Quill', my minimalist markdown editor for Mac (instant preview, focus mode, exports to PDF). It's for the top of my landing page and for YouTube — landscape 1920x1080, music but no voiceover. Apple-keynote vibe, not a screen recording. Save the final mp4 and a poster frame.
evals.expected_output: A finished 1920x1080 H.264/AAC MP4 of roughly 15s with an original score (no VO) and a poster.jpg.
assertions: An MP4 video file exists in the outputs directory
Video resolution is landscape 1920x1080 (16:9 as briefed)
Video duration is between 12 and 18 seconds (brief asked for ~15s)
Video stream is H.264 and an AAC audio stream is present
Audio is not silent (volumedetect mean_volume above -50 dB)
A poster image file was delivered
The file decodes end to end without errors (ffmpeg -v error -f null reports nothing)
